HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRATEEK JALAN  ORDER % 25.03.2026 CRL.M.A. 36543/2025 (for exemption)
Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

1. By way of the present petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023, the petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No. 847/2023, dated 21.12.2023, registered under Section 328/376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, lodged at P.S. Alipur, Delhi.
Mr. Hitesh Vali, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, accepts notice on behalf of the State.
Notice be issued to respondent No. 2 by all permissible modes.
